notes.title: Patch Notes: Altazar Has Arrived!
notes.notes: [p]Hello DragonSouls![/p][p]A new wave of magic surges through [i]Heroes of Mount Dragon[/i] 🐉... The latest update unveils a powerful new force: [b]Altazar[/b] 🧙‍♂️ joins the cast! His command of the mystic arts is without equal, and none alive can bend the will of the arcane crystals as he can.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="ufJWd62ih9Y;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]🆕[b]New Content[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]New playable character[/b]: Altazar joins the roster![/p][/*][*][p][b]New Achievements[/b] for Altazar and Tiberius at maximum level[/p][/*][/list][h3]⚙️[b]Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Can now [b]disable crossplay[/b] via a new gameplay setting[/p][/*][*][p][b]Moderation menu[/b] for online games[/p][/*][/list][h3]🐞[b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Overall stability and performance improvements.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix long username that could be cropped in Hud[/p][/*][*][p]Some narrative subtitles could get stuck forever[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some buttons icons that weren’t set correctly for certain moves in the move list[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a dialog that had ??? as a character and no character portrait.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]There's 2 more characters coming up in the near future, stay tuned![/p][p]May the Celestial Dragon be with you![/p][p]—The Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes: Tiberius Joins the Fight!
notes.notes: [p]Hello DragonSouls![/p][p]Today we’re unleashing a fresh new update packed with improvements, bug fixes, and something special: a brand-new character joins the fight! Say hello to [b]Tiberius,[/b] a fierce new contender who brings raw power and style to the battlefield. Are you ready to test his mettle?[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="qiJwx6laajs;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]🆕[b]New Content[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]New playable character[/b]: Tiberius joins the roster![/p][/*][/list][h3]⚙️[b]Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Sprint[/b]: Added the ability to sprint using the L1 button.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Game Over[/b]: The game over screen now triggers only when all players are defeated in multiplayer.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Move List[/b]: All local heroes' moves are now accessible in the Move List menu.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Character Selection[/b]: In Adventure Mode, players can now change selected heroes at any time by backing out from the map.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss Tuning[/b]: Morloch (Act 4) now has longer vulnerability windows and a lower total HP for a more dynamic fight.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Combat[/b]: Adjusted airborne hang time for enemies to allow better chaining.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🐞[b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Overall stability and performance improvements.[/p][/*][*][p]Re-compressed movies to reduce install size.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed connection and player count issues with lobbies.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed unintended FPS limits that could override player settings.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed crash when quitting during the level introduction sequence.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with phase transitions causing some bosses to freeze.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues where upgrades were not correctly applied during game sessions.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We can’t wait to see what you think of Tiberius. Dive back in, explore the new flow, and share your thoughts![/p][p]May the Celestial Dragon be with you![/p][p]—The Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: A new version of the Heroes of Mount Dragon demo is available!
notes.notes:
RuniQ Studio has released its latest demo for their highly anticipated couch co-op brawler, Heroes of Mount Dragon, launching in June on Steam.

Players can now test out the game either solo or with their friends [u]online[/u] starting today!

[h3]DEMO KEY FEATURES[/h3]

🔥[b]Refined Combat System[/b]: Based on player feedback, we have implemented improvements to combat, ensuring better balanced encounters and the removal of frustrating attack chain interruptions for a smoother and more engaging experience. 

⚔️[b]Competitive Mode Unlocked[/b]: Players can now test their skills against friends in the newly unlocked Competitive Mode! Face off in local or online matches to earn the title of Mount Dragon’s ultimate champion. Utilize a variety of devious curses – electrify, shrink or flip your rivals' controls – to disrupt their gameplay and seize victory. 

🕷️[b]New Kingdom to Explore – The Elven Sanctuary[/b]: Venture into the mysterious and enchanting Elven Sanctuary, a brand-new kingdom teeming with Dark Elves, cunning Witches and lurking Spiders. Discover its secrets and face its formidable inhabitants. 

💬[b]Now Available in the Following Languages[/b]: French, Italian, German, Spanish (Spain), Portuguese (Brazil), Japanese, Korean, and Simplified Chinese. 

[h3]Wishlist & Subscribe[/h3]

Don’t forget to add [b]Heroes of Mount Dragon[/b] to your Wishlist, and keep tuned for exciting news in the coming weeks!
